Game Overview

In Memory Fusion, the core idea is straightforward: dive into a memory challenge as Rai, embarking on a daring rescue mission. Recall and select the right path across perilous rivers to save your friend from danger. Each level tests your memory's strength, offering thrilling brain-teasers amidst stunning visuals. Fail to remember, and it's game over!
